name: chamnan
description: chamnan — one plugin that makes a long-lived codebase know itself, so an agent stops rediscovering it on every session.

plugins.name: chamnan
plugins.description: Makes a codebase know itself: an architecture index the agent reads instead of scanning files, work state that survives compaction, and a workspace that accumulates the procedures and tools you keep re-deriving. For long-lived repos, not one-off scripts.
